title: Lior and the Well
author: Oscar Villalobos
blurb: Dominic Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
